patterns: APPSC asks one-line identification: Ghatika = settlement/school of Brahmin scholars; Kalyanakaraka = Ugradityacharya (asked in G2 2012, 2019).
Other recurring G2 keys in notes: Chellavva patronised by Chalukya Bhima I (Attili), Potlacheruvu = Jain centre, Nedumba Vasati donor.
Distractors are usually Jain scholars/works of the region (Somadeva Suri, Padmaprabha) - learn author-work pairs.
App adds many administrative-term and grant-donor items; sound but more granular than the PYQs, which stay single-fact.
